title: Kurubushi Kyoudai Gekijou Daiikkan: Mahjong-hen
native_title: 踝兄弟劇場 第一巻 麻雀篇
overview: Kurubushi Kyōdai Gekijō Dai-ikkan: Mahjong-hen ("Ankle Brothers Theater Volume 1: Mahjong Edition") is a 4-player reach mahjong game featuring a cast of bizarre cartoon characters. The main story mode has the player complete a series of matches against randomly-selected opponents; each of the playable characters has their own story campaign with several chapters, all of which are suitably strange and told via still illustrations. There is also a free battle mode where the player can set up a match with any of the eight characters and customize the game rules.
